b6_reason: Heartwood is dark and insect-resistant because secondary metabolites (tannins, resins, gums, oils) are secreted and deposited in the lumen of the vessels in the central layers of the stem - statements (a) and (b).
b6_working: (a) true: heartwood forms as secondary metabolites are deposited in the lumina of vessels and tracheids, which stop conducting. (b) true: the deposition is in the central/innermost layers. (c) false: suberin in an outer layer describes cork, not xylem. (d) false: the deposits are central, not peripheral - the peripheral secondary xylem is the light-coloured sapwood. (e) false: parenchyma with functionally active xylem elements describes sapwood. So (a) and (b) = option 1; option 4 is excluded because (d) contradicts (b) on location.
